articles.title: A 40-Year Mistake About a Tiny 'Cretaceous Rabbit'
articles.summary: Scientists found a nearly complete fossil in Mongolia's Gobi Desert that changes what we know about a strange ancient mammal. For 40 years, they thought it was related to humans — it wasn't.

articles.title: Why Astronauts Get Constipated in Space — Scientists Finally Know
articles.summary: Blood samples from 52 astronauts show that gut bacteria start fermenting protein within weeks of arriving in space. The likely cause? Microgravity slows food moving through the intestines.

articles.title: Starship Reaches Orbit for the First Time — Then Explodes After Splashdown
articles.summary: SpaceX's Starship made it to orbit for the first time, but an engine failure cut the mission short. After splashing down in the Pacific, the rocket exploded — which was expected.
